info.title: Rackium API
info.description: Generated from the Zod contracts in @rackium/shared.

post.summary: Create an organisation and its Org Admin; sends a verification email
Sign in; sets httpOnly session cookies
Rotate the refresh cookie and issue a new access cookie
Ask for a reset link (always accepted)
Set a new password and end every session
Accept an invitation and sign in

get.summary: The signed-in user and their memberships

post.summary: Invite a person to the organisation or a project (Org Admin)

409.description: Already a member or already invited

patch.summary: Change a membership role or scopes (Org Admin)

delete.summary: Revoke a membership (Org Admin); the last Org Admin cannot be revoked

post.summary: Create a project; the creator becomes its PM

get.summary: Audit entries, newest first (policy: view audit log)
